## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall boy with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. He features a splendid chin and often wears a mouth twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever and ambitious young man with his own distinct thoughts about the world. Known for his playful nature, he frequently teases and makes fun of the girls around him, though his academic rivalries remain entirely good-natured. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life and put the best into it, he is also motivated by the necessity of earning his own way through college.

## History

After spending three years in Alberta with his ill father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). On his first day back at school, he pulled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's braid and called her 'Carrots,' receiving a smashed slate over his head for the insult; despite his contrite apology, she refused to forgive him, initiating an intense academic rivalry between them. Months later, Gilbert rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from a leaky boat at a bridge pile and offered his friendship, but she rejected him once more. The two continued their fierce academic competition through Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where Gilbert ultimately won the medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) earned the Avery scholarship. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) intended to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Gilbert selflessly gave up his position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so she could take the job, prompting the pair to finally forgive their past feud and become close friends.

## Quotes

> ““All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."

> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)

> "It was my fault Mr. Phillips. I teased her."

> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship as fierce academic rivals after Gilbert provoked her on his first day back at school by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots', leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to break her slate over his head and refuse his apology. Their rivalry drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to throw herself into her studies to compete against him for top marks. After Gilbert later rescued her from a stranded flatboat and offered an apology, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially rejected his bid for friendship, though their relationship eventually evolved into a reconciled friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +18 more_
